og.title: How to choose a Korean sunscreen
tips: PA++++ is the top UVA grade.
Mineral (무기자차) suits sensitive skin.
Chemical (유기자차) feels lighter.
Look for the No white cast tag.
og.pick: Round Lab Birch Juice Moisturizing Sunscreen

og.title: How to choose a Korean toner
tips: Korean toner hydrates, it is not an astringent.
Toner pads with PHA: quick gentle exfoliation.
Dry skin: glycerin, panthenol, hyaluronic acid.
Sensitive skin: centella or mugwort.

og.title: Korean serum, essence or ampoule?
tips: The names have no legal difference.
Pick by active ingredient, not the word.
Niacinamide: tone and oil control.
Centella, heartleaf: soothing.
og.pick: Abib Hyaluronic Boom Serum Water Drop

og.title: How to choose a Korean moisturizer
tips: Gel cream: oily skin, hot weather.
Ceramide barrier cream: dry skin, winter.
Centella or panthenol: redness.
Seal in toner and serum with it.
